verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents natural-language operation for its Agent feature: you create an agent in the dashboard by describing the goal in plain language, the Stagehand SDK offers natural-language selectors, and paused runs resume when you reply. Natural language is not shown as a way to operate the broader product, such as managing sessions, settings, or webhooks, and the claims rest only on vendor docs. missing for 10: natural-language control of the broader platform beyond agent goals and selectors, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
the Agent can pause the run, tell you what it needs, and continue exactly where it left off once you reply.
